name: kage-bunshin-lite
description: kage-bunshin (그림자 분신술) lite — plain-text brief → Amazon Bedrock → slot-constrained JSON spec → branded eDM/newsletter HTML. Theme folders (templates/<theme>) own the design; the AI only writes copy.

scripts.template:build: node scripts/build-template.mjs && node scripts/build-schema-v2.mjs && node scripts/build-design-v2.mjs
scripts.build: npm run sync:templates && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --prefix infra
